text:
Olivia: midweek async — quick pulse: what I did / blockers / today

Olivia: Did full Snyk + Trivy sweep on staging after the deploy. Found 2 medium findings in the analytics image (libxml2, commons-io). No high. Started a scoped upgrade PR for commons-io.

Sam: thanks. Can you drop the Snyk output link? I want to see the paths.

Olivia: https://snyk.io/org/redwood/project/12345 -> summarized in the run: 2 medium. Also ran Trivy: `trivy image --severity MEDIUM,HIGH registry.redwood/analytics:staging`

Priya: heads up — KMS rotation dry-run window is 02:00-03:00 UTC tomorrow. If you need to test key access, do it before 01:30 UTC.

Diego: re: flaky encrypt/decrypt test — I reproduced locally, likely due to concurrent key fetch TTL. Adding a 200ms backoff helped. I'll open a tiny fix.

Maya: pinging @Sam for CI service account token so Olivia can run the canary job against staging. Also, is there any compliance doc I should attach to the PR for the commons-io bump?

Sam: I'll create a short service token with limited scope and add it to the `olivia-ci-service` secret by EOD. For compliance, add a note linking to: https://docs.redwood/inference/security/deps-upgrade-guidance

Olivia: started PR #6187 with the commons-io bump and a test matrix run. Marked it `engsec/needs-review`. Small snippet in the PR: ```diff
- <dependency>
-   <groupId>commons-io</groupId>
-   <artifactId>commons-io</artifactId>
-   <version>2.6</version>
- </dependency>
+ <dependency>
+   <groupId>commons-io</groupId>
+   <artifactId>commons-io</artifactId>
+   <version>2.11.0</version>
+ </dependency>
```

engsec-bot: Weekly dependency scan completed — 2 MEDIUM, 0 HIGH. Summary: commons-io (CVE-XXXX-2024), libxml2 advisory linked. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/sec/deps

Priya: quick question — do we want to postpone the KMS rotation if the analytics canary is still running? I'd prefer to avoid rotating while migrations are live.

Olivia: yes, let's postpone rotation to the next maintenance window if canary overlaps. I'll update the rotation ticket.

Sam: noted. I'll aim to finish the CI token and ping here when ready. Thanks all.

Maya: no blockers from my side. I'll review PR #6187 after the CI runs.

Olivia: thanks — closing my loop, will post a follow-up if the canary fails.
